content.comment_body: The program password in a [product_name] application has been accidentally enabled. Is there a way to reset this password without knowing the current password?
You can delete the program stored on your [product_name]. This would give you a device without a program or password. Otherwise, try using this password ****.
Thanks for your response. I wasn't very clear before. The password was set in [product_name] software (File -> properties, Parameter tab). I want to remove the password in the software itself.
Hello, Just leave all fields empty and transfer the program back to the device.

Hello, If I leave the fields empty, the password remains unchanged because I don’t know the current password. It appears I need to enter the existing password before leaving the new password fields blank, but I don’t have the original password. Is there a way to reset it?
Sorry, but it's not easy. The only way to remove the previous password is to completely erase the [product_name].

Hi, If you have the program on your PC and forgot the password, you can: 1. Select all blocks and copy them into a new project without a password. 2. Delete the program from the device. 3. Download the new program back to the device.

Thank you for the replies! I went with the copy-paste method. It still required a lot of work after pasting, as many references were lost. It seems the paste action starts from the top, so any block with references to blocks not yet inserted are left blank. I had to review all blocks and correct the parameters manually. Regardless, the issue is resolved now.
I think the software should let everything work smoothly, given how configurable it is. For consistency and efficiency, it would help if this process could be handled on a better platform.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter considerable difficulties when trying to reset or remove a program password in [product_name] software without knowing the original password. The main workaround is to copy all program blocks into a new project, but this is time-consuming and often leads to lost references and extra manual corrections. There is no simple or user-friendly way to recover or reset the password, causing frustration and additional effort.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an easy and intuitive process for resetting or removing a forgotten program password in [product_name] software, ideally without risking data loss or dealing with complex manual corrections.
